Class StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.ServletRequestWrapper
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper
org.springframework.web.multipart.support.AbstractMultipartHttpServletRequest
org.springframework.web.multipart.support.StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.ServletRequest, MultipartHttpServletRequest, MultipartRequest
public class StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest extends AbstractMultipartHttpServletRequest
Spring MultipartHttpServletRequest 适配器，封装了 Servlet HttpServletRequest 及其 Part 对象。参数通过原生请求的 getParameter 方法暴露——无需我们进行任何自定义处理。
Since:
3.1
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller，Rossen Stoyanchev
See Also:

    • getMultipartHeaders

      public @Nullable HttpHeaders getMultipartHeaders(String paramOrFileName)
      描述从接口复制：MultipartHttpServletRequest
      Return the headers for the specified part of the multipart request.

      如果底层实现支持访问部分头信息，则返回所有头信息。否则，例如对于文件上传，返回的头信息可能会在可用时暴露“Content-Type"。
